UI_LPBCS_Opt_Enabled_tooltip: Draw the name written on a crate or cabinet in the world. Turning this off hides every sign for you only; the names themselves are untouched.
UI_LPBCS_Opt_Radius_tooltip: How far a sign stays readable. Signs fade out over the last two tiles instead of blinking away. Lower this in a dense base.
UI_LPBCS_Opt_Opacity_tooltip: How solid the signs are drawn.
UI_LPBCS_Opt_HideWhenLoot: Hide while the loot window is open
UI_LPBCS_Opt_HideWhenLoot_tooltip: Clears the signs off the screen while you are actually rummaging through a container, when you no longer need them.
